d: Rodney blames Cherise for their business failure and eviction while Cherise says Rodney gets into public brawls and the couple fear they have lost the respect of their only son.
Syncere says Mark has lied and disrespected her on several occasions, and she's not going to stand for it anymore  he says he cheats on her because she has a bad attitude, and she gets on his nerves.

Kiyah says Christopher has several phones, and she caught him booking a trip to the Bahamas even though he doesn't have a job  Christopher says Kiyah is being paranoid and needs to stop watching every move he makes.
Kathy and Nicci are ready for their rocky relationship to end: arguments and accusations of infidelity have taken a toll on the marriage, and now Kathy says she's in love with another woman.
Tyrice has given Tarvoria the world -- a new house, a car and a beautiful ring -- but she refuses to get married, because she feels she can't trust him after she caught him cheating with a man.
Kay says her husband, Dwayne, has been pulling a disappearing act on her and their 11 kids, and she's fed up with his infidelity and being embarrassed in their community.
James and Wisda have been together 18 months and Wisda is ready for a ring  James feels it's too soon to talk marriage and worries Wisda's two failed marriages are a sign things won't turn out well.
Henri and Johnnie's last attempt at rekindling their relationship in Las Vegas ended in disaster as they both were on their own most of the trip.
It's been 13 years, and Mapeasta is ready to walk down the aisle, but her fiancé, Gerry, says her jealous paranoia and bad temper are giving him cold feet.
Charles is fed up with handing over his paycheck to Alicia every week and claims she's constantly calling him names  Alicia says Charles needs to stop being so insecure and accusing her of cheating.

Baby mama drama has taken a toll on Charita and Reginald's relationship  she feels like she isn't a priority and craves more attention  he says her bad attitude and aggressive nature are pushing him away.
Sara and Branden met online, and drugs soon became a major factor in their relationship  now that they're both clean and sober, fighting over family issues is tearing them apart.

Rodney and Melissa have been through a lot of ups and downs in the eight years they've been together  he gave her a promise ring six years ago but recently took it back because, he says, she's not fulfilling his needs.

Saquala and Lawrence's marriage was a roller coaster ride that ended in divorce  she says he cheated throughout the relationship, and she can't trust him  he wants her back and is ready to get married again.

Michaela feels that Richard is a grumpy old man who is always talking down to her  he says he just wants to settle down and enjoy the rest of his life and says that her constant nagging is making him rethink his decision to marry her.
Brandy says she's stripping to provide a better life for her and Letrey, but he thinks she's cheating when she's at work  baby mama drama is also wreaking havoc on their relationship.
Theotis says he is tired of the constant verbal abuse from Tonesha  she says that, because of his constant cheating and non-communication, she is ready to move on with her life.
